label: PF Backlog 694
title: Governed Knowledge Fabric & Registry: asset registration, schema validation, authority tiers, and SHA-256 provenance tracking
body:
## Problem / why
Knowledge assets (ADRs, SSOT docs, code standards, glossaries) lack a formal registry, versioning, and tamper-evident provenance.

## Goal & value
Implement the Knowledge Fabric registry inside Product Forge to register, validate, version, and trace all authoritative knowledge assets.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-7`
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-16`

## In scope
- Knowledge registry schema (asset_id, category, authority_tier, version, sha256, owner, valid_until).
- Validation gate rejecting unclassified, unversioned, or invalid knowledge chunks.
- Cryptographic provenance: every chunk links back to source file, heading anchor, and git commit SHA.

## Out of scope
- Third-party standalone OKF servers; keep logic natively integrated inside Product Forge.

## Definition of Done
- Registry conformance tests pass with 100% metadata coverage across active docs.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
